## apiome upgrade {#upgrade}

Plan (and optionally apply) an upgrade to OpenAPI 3.0, 3.1 or 3.2, listing every change.

```text
apiome upgrade [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | text |  | OpenAPI / Swagger document to upgrade ('-' for stdin). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--to` | text |  | yes | Target OpenAPI version: 3.0, 3.1 or 3.2. |
| `--project` | text |  |  | Project or catalog item (id or slug) to upgrade. |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version to upgrade (id or label; default: latest). |
| `--apply` | flag |  |  | Store the upgraded document as a new version (--project only). |
| `--version-label` | text |  |  | Label of the new version (with --apply; default: a date/time label). |
| `--output`, `-o` | text |  |  | Write the upgraded document here ('-' for stdout; .yaml writes YAML). |
| `--summary` | flag |  |  | Print the count per rule, not every change. |
